 K-pop boy group NCT 127 to hold concert in KL on Jan 9
 By ANNDREA A. WEBBER 
 Friday, 13 Nov 2026
 | 6:35 PM MYT
 share 
 bookmark 
 NCT 127 will be entertaining fans with a one-night show in Kuala Lumpur next year. Photo: Handout 
 Malaysian NCTzens, listen up!
 South Korean boy group NCT 127 is set to return to Kuala Lumpur next year for its first full-scale arena concert in the city.
 The Neo City – The Redline Tour will take place on Jan 9 at Unifi Arena in Bukit Jalil, marking the group’s 10th anniversary in the music industry.
 Fans can look forward to an electrifying show featuring impressive stage production, powerful vocals, hard-hitting rap verses and the group’s signature intricate choreography.
 The tour kicked off with a three-night run in Seoul in September and will also take NCT 127 to Jakarta, Hong Kong, Singapore, Saitama, Bangkok, Manila, Taipei and Macau.
 It follows the release of the group’s seventh full-length studio album Blingy , which features nine tracks blending hip-hop, rock and indie-pop influences.
 NCT 127 comprises seven members: Taeyong, Johnny, Yuta, Jaehyun, Haechan, Doyoung and Jungwoo. The latter two are currently fulfilling their mandatory military service.
 Since its formation in July 2016, the group has grown into one of K-pop’s most prominent acts, earning a global following with hits such as Cherry Bomb , Simon Says and 2 Baddies .
 Its accolades include the Album Of The Year award at the 2021 Asia Artist Awards and the Stage of the Year award at the 2024 ceremony.
 Tickets for Neo City – The Redline Tour in Kuala Lumpur are priced between RM399 and RM1,099.
 Registered NCTzen 127 Membership (GL) members can enjoy an exclusive pre-sale on Nov 19, from noon to 5pm.
 Eligible fans must register through the NCTzen 127 Membership (GL) Pre-Sale Registration page on Weverse by Nov 15 at 11.59pm.
 Public ticket sales will begin on Nov 20 at noon via http://my.bookmyshow.com .
